feature: SharedChannel publish skips unchanged worker tracker state

candidate.design: State.publish skipped worker.tracker.setState when the worker's published state and capacity were unchanged, unless the channel was closed/retired or the tracker had abandoned waiters. Worker.published is kept in sync by every external tracker-state mutation.

scope.workload: SharedChannel shared-unary persistent round trip, 262144-byte request and response

benchmark_method.schedule: five ABBA rounds; baseline, candidate, candidate, baseline
benchmark_method.host: shared host with unrelated load; no CPU pinning
benchmark_method.metric: ns_per_roundtrip from the benchmark result record

conclusion: Skipping the unchanged worker tracker update did not produce a stable gain; four of five rounds were neutral or slower. The source change was reverted. Further lock-path micro-optimization is not supported by this evidence.
